alternatives.description: Keep completion-driven selection but retain stale hourly coordinator metadata and limit compact-context/materiality semantics to the initial adapter candidate.
alternatives.projected_effect: Lower change surface, but clock-oriented metadata and repeated-context behavior remain inconsistent across Garden work roles.
alternatives.risk: Agents may continue reprocessing unchanged state or misread the ChatGPT frontier role as an OpenRouter route.

alternatives.description: Use one event/completion coordinator, reusable validated context, reason-coded materiality and dependency-aware compact deltas across applicable work roles; retain explicit full-context fallback.
alternatives.projected_effect: Reduces repeated context/compute and aligns scheduling metadata while preserving review, evidence and authority gates.
alternatives.risk: Over-aggressive compaction could hide dependencies unless closure-triggered context expansion remains fail-closed.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: No repo-wide context reuse/materiality rule and stale clock metadata remains.
Additional event fingerprints, context invalidation and full-context-fallback qualification obligations.

assumptions: GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess@1.4 remains the HUMAN-admitted governing process.
Garden v15.5 remains the immutable canonical baseline and v15.7 EDCR remains non-canonical candidate work.
Completion, repository change, evidence change, invalidation, cooldown expiry and freshness deadlines can wake work without granting authority.
Compact context is safe only when the affected dependency closure is sufficient; otherwise context must expand or the result remains unknown/incomplete.
OpenRouter reviewer/provider work and the external ChatGPT frontier lane are distinct surfaces; the repository must not hardcode a changing ChatGPT product model name.
reason.uncertainty: Durable live event delivery, context-cache invalidation metrics and the external ChatGPT handoff are not yet deployment-qualified. Cost/quality savings require empirical receipts.
counterexamples: Clock passage rotates target/model despite unchanged state.
Duplicate event fingerprint creates duplicate review work.
Compact packet omits an affected contract and prevents a required whole-source check.
Stale observation survives into a current conclusion.
OpenRouter is treated as the external ChatGPT frontier lane.
Frontier output is mistaken for independent quorum or canonical authority.
reason.conclusion: Propose the repo-wide event/delta profile and provider-boundary correction, keep the coordinator paused, require explicit whole-context fallback and independently qualify live handoff/efficiency before activation.

obligations.statement: A sole coordinator can select event/material work without a recurring clock while preserving Process route/gate authority and explicit context-expansion conditions.

items.claim_scope: User requested the event-driven/context-reuse rule be committed and applied wherever it fits, and clarified the frontier role is the ChatGPT-side lane rather than OpenRouter.
Declares event wakes, delta-first context, materiality, applicability and mandatory full-context fallbacks; non-canonical implementation profile.
Controlled binding and fail-closed tests; not independent deployment qualification.
